name: When in the renovation process should I expect to receive a detailed cost estimate from AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: When in the renovation process should I expect to receive a detailed cost estimate from AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: You will receive a detailed cost estimate after our initial consultation and once the preliminary design concepts have been discussed and refined. Our managed process begins with understanding your vision and requirements. This allows us to capture all critical elements that contribute to the project's scope. Providing this estimate at an early yet defined stage ensures that the proposed design aligns with your financial goals, preventing surprises and enabling informed decisions before construction commences. We believe in clear communication throughout, ensuring transparency from concept to completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: A detailed cost estimate is provided after the initial consultation and preliminary design concepts are refined, aligning the project with your financial goals.
